经过这么一折腾，王浩彻底没了之前的凶厉嚣张，满眼都是惊恐，浑身瑟瑟发抖，再也不敢挣扎嘶吼，乖乖地被勾魂锁链捆着，连头都不敢抬。

吴姜见状，不再耽搁，抬手掐诀，凝神默念开启阴阳通道的口诀。

片刻后，房间里的空气开始扭曲，一道泛着暗灰色光芒的阴阳通道缓缓浮现，浓郁的阴寒之气扑面而来，让人忍不住打寒颤。他拉了拉缠在王浩身上的勾魂锁链，语气冰冷，不带一丝情绪：“走，跟我去地府报到！”

王浩吓得连连点头，乖乖地被吴姜拉着，一步步走进了阴阳通道，连半点反抗的念头都没有。

吴姜看着他这副前倨后恭的模样，忍不住在心里暗骂一声：“真是个贱骨头，不打不老实！”

很快，两人就抵达了地府，依旧是熟悉的通道平台，依旧是那座阴森肃穆的酆都城。

吴姜拉着乖乖听话的王浩，不再像第一次那样好奇地四处张望，脚步匆匆，径直朝着勾魂司走去，很快就来到了任务交接处。

交接处里，还是上次那个面容严肃、不苟言笑的阴差，正低着头，认真整理着手中的卷宗，神情专注。

吴姜走上前，微微拱手，恭敬地开口说道：“勾魂司三等鬼差吴姜，前来交接游魂王浩，请大人查验。”

那阴差缓缓抬起头，看了吴姜一眼，又扫了一眼一旁乖乖站立、不敢作乱的王浩，随后拿起桌上那台类似阳间平板电脑的地府办公法器，手指在屏幕上快速划动，仔细核对起游魂信息和吴姜的任务记录。

确认无误后，他抬了抬下巴，示意吴姜在屏幕上签字确认，完成交接手续。

手续办完，吴姜想起了爷爷之前给的建议，出门在外，不管是阳间还是阴间，多结交个朋友、打好关系总没坏处，尤其是在地府，跟交接处的阴差搞好关系，以后办事也能更顺畅，少走不少弯路。

想到这里，他脸上露出一抹热情的笑容，对着阴差说道：“大哥，小弟初来乍到，刚当鬼差没多久，很多规矩和门道都不懂，以后还得麻烦大哥多指点。小弟回去之后，想给大哥在阳间烧点东西下来，也算小弟的一点心意，不知大哥意下如何？”

这话一出，那阴差原本冰冷僵硬的脸上，终于有了一丝松动，嘴角微微上扬，语气也缓和了不少，不再像之前那样冷冰冰的：“哈哈哈，小兄弟倒是懂事，会来事！既然你这么有心意，那老哥就不客气了。我叫朱宏，是大清咸丰年间人士，你到时候烧东西的时候，记得报我的名字，别烧错了。”

After such a torment, Wang Hao completely lost his previous ferocity and arrogance. His eyes were filled with fear and his whole body was trembling. He no longer dared to struggle and scream. He was obediently tied up by the soul-enchanting chains, not even daring to raise his head.

Seeing this, Wu Jiang stopped delaying, raised his hands to perform the incantation, and silently recited the incantation to open the yin and yang channel.

After a while, the air in the room began to twist, and a yin-yang passage glowing with dark gray light slowly emerged. The rich cold air rushed towards the face, making people shiver.He pulled the soul-enchanting chain wrapped around Wang Hao's body, and said in a cold tone without any emotion: "Let's go, report to the underworld with me!"

Wang Hao was so frightened that he nodded repeatedly and was pulled by Wu Jiang obediently. He walked into the Yin and Yang passage step by step without even the slightest thought of resistance.

Wu Jiang looked at his arrogant and respectful look, and couldn't help but cursed in his heart: "What a bastard, you can't be honest if you don't fight him!"

Soon, the two of them arrived at the underworld. It was still the familiar passage platform, and it was still the eerie and solemn Fengdu City.

Wu Jiang pulled Wang Hao, who was obedient, and no longer looked around curiously like the first time. He walked hurriedly towards the Soul Enchanting Division and soon arrived at the task handover.

In the handover office, the same serious and unsmiling Yin Zai from last time was still looking down, carefully sorting out the files in his hands, with a focused look on his face.

Wu Jiang stepped forward, slightly cupped his hands, and said respectfully: "Wu Jiang, the third-class ghost officer of the Soul Seduction Department, is here to hand over the ghost Wang Hao. Please check it out."

The Yin Chai slowly raised his head, glanced at Wu Jiang, and then glanced at Wang Hao, who was standing obediently and not daring to cause trouble. Then he picked up the underworld magic weapon on the table, which was similar to a tablet computer in the world. He quickly swiped his fingers on the screen and carefully checked the wandering soul information and Wu Jiang's mission records.

After confirming that it was correct, he raised his chin and motioned Wu Jiang to sign on the screen to confirm and complete the handover procedure.

After the formalities were completed, Wu Jiang remembered the advice his grandfather had given him before. It never hurts to make more friends and build good relationships when traveling, whether in the underworld or in the underworld. Especially in the underworld, if you have a good relationship with the underworld at the handover, things will go more smoothly in the future and avoid many detours.

Thinking of this, a warm smile appeared on his face, and he said to Yin Chai: "Brother, I have just arrived here. I have just been a ghost sergeant for a short time. I don't understand many rules and ways. I have to ask my brother for more guidance in the future. After I go back, I want to burn something for my brother in the world. This is my little kindness. I wonder what your thoughts are?"

As soon as these words came out, Yin Zha's cold and stiff face finally became looser. The corners of his mouth rose slightly, and his tone softened a lot. He was no longer as cold as before: "Hahaha, little brother is sensible and knows what to do! Since you are so thoughtful, I won't be polite. My name is Zhu Hong, and I am from the Xianfeng period of the Qing Dynasty. When you burn something, remember to give my name, so as not to burn the wrong thing."
